findings.finding: Child classroom join, drawing persistence, and reconnect were previously local/stubbed.
remediation_evidence: Child QR and shared six-digit room-code joins create the same pending BE1 device grant; Child polls join-status and learns organization/session scope only after admission.
Successful Teacher Start advances the shared stage and revokes every pending grant in the same transaction; admitted grants remain.

Room-code HMAC persistence, per-source sliding 15-minute throttle, Child/Teacher wiring and mocked tests are implemented locally. PostgreSQL transaction acceptance and physical-device QR/deep-link tests remain open.
remaining: No PostgreSQL-backed FE-to-BE receipt; BE1_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset.
Checkpoint snapshot hydration and durable offline queue are absent.
Production trusted-proxy/source-IP configuration requires review; 40-child target remains unmeasured.

findings.finding: Compatibility backend composition exposed classroom and local/demo routers together without explicit classroom-first entrypoint.
remediation_evidence: Separate classroom-only and demo-only app compositions/entrypoints exist; compatibility create_app() keeps its old combined route surface.
Backend app-composition and session contract tests pass 10/10.
remaining: Actual deployed process command/container configuration has not been verified.
